caption: Output power against current for a laser with a 20 mA threshold and a 0.30 W/A slope. The trace is flat at zero up to threshold, then straight: 40 mA gives 6 mW and 60 mA gives 12 mW.

spec.aria: Plot of laser output power against current: zero below 20 mA threshold, then a straight line with slope 0.3 mW per mA.
